categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics Tech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, testing, sales, and services of special integrated circuits. Its product portfolio includes digital integrated circuits such as programmable logic devices (FPGA, CPLD, SoPC, RF-FPGA), microcontrollers (MCU), system-on-chip (SoC), and memory chips, as well as analog integrated circuits including ADC/DAC converters, interface and driver circuits, and power management chips. The company also provides ASIC/SoC system-level chip solutions and integrated circuit testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor design technologies including 28nm CMOS process for high-performance FPGA chips, and various CMOS processes for analog and mixed-signal chips. It has proprietary FPGA architecture, high-speed and high-precision ADC/DAC design, embedded FPGA (eFPGA) technology, and system-level chip (SoC) integration. Manufacturing is outsourced via a fabless model, with wafer fabrication and packaging handled by specialized external foundries, while testing and quality control are conducted in-house with a CNAS-certified national-level testing center.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly large state-owned enterprises and central government-affiliated groups in China, including China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. The products serve specialized fields such as electronics, communications, control systems, and measurement equipment, focusing on high-reliability and high-performance applications in special industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main offices located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Its sales and marketing efforts cover domestic markets extensively, with no significant international sales reported. The company’s supply chain and manufacturing partners are also primarily domestic or regional.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design, development, and testing. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging to external foundries and subcontractors, positioning itself upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a design and testing specialist rather than a manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, dedicating over 25% of revenue to research and development. Strategic priorities include advancing high-performance FPGA, high-speed and high-precision ADC/DAC chips, intelligent heterogeneous SoC chips, and MCU products. It aims to build a unified digital-analog mixed-signal design platform, enhance domestic chip design capabilities, and develop integrated system solutions (SiP). Collaboration with universities and national projects supports innovation and talent cultivation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated circuit products and related technical services. The company employs a direct sales model with a structured sales network covering major domestic customers. Income also includes government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue stream is product sales and technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics is positioned as a leading domestic player in the special integrated circuit design sector, particularly in programmable logic devices (CPLD/FPGA) and high-precision ADC chips. It competes with other domestic and international semiconductor design firms but distinguishes itself through its focus on special-grade integrated circuits with high reliability and performance. The company is recognized as a key national project participant and holds a leading position in China’s special IC industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 603.9 million, a 34.79% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 122.17 million, down 60.73%. Total assets reached RMB 3.67 billion, up 61.36%, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 114% to RMB 2.81 billion, reflecting capital injections from its IPO. The company is in a growth phase with significant R&D investment but experienced revenue and profit declines due to market demand fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly reliable, high-performance special integrated circuits tailored for demanding applications in electronics, communications, control, and measurement industries. Its products feature advanced proprietary technologies, including high gate-count FPGA chips, high-speed and ultra-high precision ADC/DAC converters, and intelligent heterogeneous SoC designs. The company’s comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, national project endorsements, and in-house testing facilities provide customers with integrated, secure, and domestically sourced semiconductor solutions that meet stringent reliability and performance requirements.
